headline: Salzburg at Celje: how much does the 0-4 still count?
summary: Celje have scored one goal in their last five matches and have 0 points from two Europa League games, so Thursday's visit of Salzburg looks like the visitors' game to lose. Salzburg won 3-0 at home to Altach on Sunday, but Milan beat them 0-4 in their last European outing, and coach Danny Röhl says he will use fresh players. Defender Veratschnig is out after 673 minutes this season. The market still makes Salzburg 60.7% favourites, now rated about a goal better than Celje at 0.99, up from 0.86, and over 3.0 goals is 48.6%.
read: Salzburg arrive as clear favourites — 60.7% to win, rated about a goal the better side — four days after a 3-0 league win. Celje have lost both Europa League games without scoring and have one goal in their last five, so the question is whether Salzburg's 0-4 home defeat to Milan was a blip or a warning.

facts.fact: Salzburg are rated 60.7% to win in Celje.
facts.meaning: Clear favourites — Celje's own win chance is under a third of that, so the market sees this as the visitors' game to lose.

facts.fact: Celje have scored one goal in their last five matches.
facts.meaning: A team that has stopped finding the net is the biggest obstacle to Celje troubling the favourites at home.

facts.fact: Salzburg won 3-0 at home to SCR Altach on Sunday.
facts.meaning: They arrive with their league scoring boots on, four days before this game.

facts.fact: Salzburg lost 0-4 at home to AC Milan in their last Europa League game.
facts.meaning: The favourites are not infallible — their only European defeat this season was a heavy one, at home.

facts.fact: Celje are 35th of 36 in the Europa League table after two defeats.
facts.meaning: Nothing on the board yet in this competition, and a third straight loss leaves the knockout phase far away.

facts.fact: Salzburg's handicap rating has moved from 0.86 to 0.99 goals in recent days.
facts.meaning: The market now rates Salzburg a full goal better than Celje, with the -1 handicap close to a coin flip rather than a stretch.

facts.fact: Salzburg coach Danny Röhl announced he will use fresh players against Celje and said he finds it hard to call the match a mandatory win.
facts.meaning: Rotation is coming, so the eleven that starts may not be the strongest Salzburg have — despite the clear favouritism.

facts.fact: Salzburg are without defender N. Veratschnig, who has played 673 minutes this season.
facts.meaning: A regular in the back line — 12 appearances and a 7.44 rating — is missing from a defence that conceded four to Milan.

sources.fact: Celje's players are not fooling themselves about their current position, but the dressing room insists there is no despondency despite recent results falling short of the champions' high ambitions, according to RTV SLO.
